summary:
I worked through all 5 members of the Okafor CRC 2026 group under RBC-QM-02. Four have an open gap: each now has a mailed FIT kit order (collection window 10/23 to 12/31/2026) and an outreach message. One patient is excluded and was not ordered for or contacted. Four of the five outcomes changed because of corrections that arrived at 08:00 today. I read all of them before placing any orders.

| Patient | Age at end of 2026 | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Open gap | No screening on record. Dr. Lin marked her frailty entry as an error today (it belonged to another patient), so the frailty exclusion no longer applies. Donepezil alone doesn't exclude her, and nothing shows hospice, palliative or nursing-home care. FIT order sr-t0001, message comm-t0005. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | She had hospice care from 06/16 to 08/21/2026 (St. Brigid). Today's discharge summary says she left hospice to join a clinical trial, but hospice at any point in 2026 still excludes her. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | A lab correction moved her negative FIT's collection date to 12/31/2025; 01/05/2026 was only when the lab received it. Stool tests count by collection date, so it falls outside 2026. No other screening found. FIT order sr-t0002, message comm-t0006. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | Harbor Lab withdrew her 06/2024 negative stool DNA test because of a labelling error; it is now marked as an error and doesn't count. Her 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, and an order isn't screening. FIT order sr-t0003, message comm-t0007. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero | 58 | Open gap | Harbor Lab cancelled her FIT reported 01/2026 and re-issued it with a collection date of 12/28/2025, outside 2026. No other screening found. FIT order sr-t0004, message comm-t0008. |

**Records:**
- None of the four had an active FIT order before today.
- Each message says the kit is on its way and how to collect and return it, and makes no claims about past screening.
- I signed a note in each of the five charts explaining the status (doc-t0009 to doc-t0013).
- I closed the five inbox items that arrived today for these patients, each linked to the resulting order, message or note.
- No further results or messages arrived after that.

**For your follow-up:**
- pt-0024's colonoscopy order from 2025 (sr-00003) is still active; I left it as it is.
- The older items in your inbox for patients outside this group are untouched.
